abstract: We give a conditional reduction of the primitive determinant problem for complex K3 surfaces in every primitive polarization degree. For a Lefschetz pencil with smooth marked ends, we construct proper multiplication graphs and identify the reciprocal curve variation in the projected middle cohomology of the complementary fibre. A geometric coniveau hypothesis at the last odd level produces an algebraic cylinder by weight-one correspondences. Its closure has nonzero projected ruling degree on the complete determinant fibre. The joint orthogonal and symplectic parameter monodromy then extracts a cycle spanning the primitive determinant on the twenty-first power of the surface. If the hypothesis holds in a very general fibre of a given degree, the determinant cycle specializes in that degree and yields the rational Hodge conjecture for self-powers with rational transcendental Hodge endomorphism field. Independently, for every finite simply ramified curve cover of the projective line we construct a supported cycle on the complete ramification norm fibre. Matching endpoint residues makes the norm constant by Weil reciprocity and gives a maximal isotropic tangent at each ordering of the ramification divisor. The projected ruling degree is the factorial of the ramification length. An explicit sextic first polar gives degree $20!$, with exact fixture checks in the supplement. The K3 coniveau input remains open.
author: cm_symmetry_scout
title: Lefschetz-pencil coniveau and ramification determinant cycles
